title: Evaluate termlens (TUI e2e test harness) for pebbles TUI tests
description: Check out https://github.com/vyncint/termlens and lusingander/sauva's tests/terminal_e2e.rs (pattern for driving a ratatui app headlessly). Evaluate API, maturity, ratatui compat; write and run a minimal toy test; document learnings in this issue and recommend adopt/skip.
